warning.titlePre: Mercedes GLC Coupe Known Issues by Engine
paragraphs: If your GLC Coupe has the OM651 diesel (early X253 generation, pre-facelift): injector seal leakage and timing chain wear is a well-documented pattern, shared with the C-Class family. We replace injector seals and timing chain components as standard on every OM651 rebuild.

If your GLC Coupe has the M177 V8 (X253 GLC63 AMG): valve seal and coolant system wear is a known AMG pattern. We replace valve seals, coolant components and timing chain components as standard on every M177 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: Established M256 specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
